title: The Unlit Stars
text: Out here the stars are unlit, hanging like dead lamps on threads of nothing, cold and grey. One hangs low enough to reach, if someone climbs. It turns slowly, as if looking for someone.

options.label: The quickest climbs to the low star, to bring it down.

outcomes.text: They bring it down, cold and heavy and humming.
They fall a long way, in a place with no ground.

options.label: The wisest tries to light it again, so it may see what it seeks.

outcomes.text: It flickers, and for a moment you can see the way home.

options.label: Do not look up. Whoever it is looking for, it is not you.

outcomes.text: It is hard not to, and it keeps turning toward you.
